related.title: Webb 分段鏡波前定相與光程差
related.titleEn: Webb segmented mirror phasing and optical path difference
related.transfer: 沿衛星組態、測試設備、任務管制與交班對照邊界。
related.transferEn: Compare boundaries across spacecraft configuration, test equipment, mission control, and handover.
related.why: 兩課都要求可複查的測試矩陣及異常關閉紀錄；請先找到證據格式的共通欄位。
related.whyEn: Both courses require a reviewable test matrix and discrepancy closure record. First find the evidence fields they share.
related.difference: 完成「Webb 分段鏡波前定相與光程差」工作台並留下可重做的工程紀錄。
related.differenceEn: Complete the webb segmented mirror phasing and optical path difference bench and produce a reproducible engineering record.
practice: 各選一個名義結果，保留輸入與來源。
對照介面、失效條件與資料解析度。
把一項驗證改編到另一案例，記下不可沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Select one nominal result in each case, retaining inputs and sources.
Compare interfaces, failure conditions, and data resolution.
Transfer a verification to the other case and document assumptions that do not carry across.

courses.overview: 比較整合、測試與任務營運中兩種案例的介面與驗證方法，並轉移一個工程判斷。
courses.overviewEn: Compare interfaces and verification approaches in two integration, testing, and mission operations cases, then transfer one engineering judgment.
